why: Deletions a reviewer has judged superseded, keyed by the deleted path.
`node local/sync/post-sync.mjs` inventories the exported surface of every deleted fork-only module
and fails when an export has no surviving reference. That is the right default: a module disappearing
is exactly when a caller can leave with it. This file is how a reviewed supersession is recorded so
the check can pass without weakening it.
Each entry must name the live replacement and the evidence for calling it a superset — the check
prints this, so the next sync inherits the reasoning instead of re-deriving it.
An entry whose path is no longer deleted is reported as stale, so this file cannot rot unnoticed.
Entries are therefore per sync: a previous sync's acknowledgements are pruned once their deletion is
no longer part of the tip..HEAD range.

src/main/runtime/session-lifecycle/proje.evidence: Upstream's 2026-10-25 rewrite of the sleep-record pane claim moved the module and dropped the fork's claimWindowWakeRecordForPane/isWindowWakeSleepRecord helpers; the sibling export markResumedRecordLive carried over and still has 3 references, so the module's live surface moved rather than vanished.

src/renderer/src/components/task-page-li.evidence: Upstream grouped the task-page Linear modules under task-page/linear/. The old path's findTaskPageLinearDrawerIssue has no caller in the merged tree; the drawer issue is resolved through the grouped selectors module instead.

src/renderer/src/components/use-task-pag.evidence: Same task-page/linear/ grouping. The TaskPageLinearCollectionEffectsPreludeModel type was folded into the grouped module's own state shape and has no importer anywhere in the merged tree.

src/renderer/src/lib/linear-agent-skill-.evidence: The fork built its Linear skill command in a local helper; upstream replaced that with the shared builder, which every surviving caller now uses (AgentSkillSetupPanel, WslLinearAgentSkillInstallCta, FeatureWallBrowserAction, AgentCapabilitiesSetupAction). Upstream's is a superset: it still pins to the build's commit, and ORCA_SKILLS_REPOSITORY_URL keeps the fork's nplez1/orca pin.

src/shared/remote-runtime-shared-control.evidence: Upstream grouped the remote-runtime modules under remote-runtime/control/. closeSharedControlSubscription lost its caller in that rewrite; the grouped module owns the subscription lifecycle now.
